note: Found by the inventory's pass two (the Game/Screen whole read, 11-18, every line cited read at 6577392b5). Workarounds of the same scheme: NebulaAchievementToast.cpp:388, NebulaUi.cpp:571-575 (readScreen's 0.75), NebulaAchievementBoard.cpp:53, WipeRing.cpp:209; empty isScreen16Per9 branches left where the console adjusted an angle, StarPointerCommandStream.cpp:91-92 and StarPointerLayout.cpp:708-710, whose ribbon and nozzle angles are taken in square screen units and handed to panes in layout units. Anchor.hpp:22-26, :44), and a slide's off-screen x is in 16:9 units. 11-18 (the harness's System report, checked at 241395b49): the two-shape switch's input is the console's widescreen setting kept as a host setting of 0 or 1 (NebulaSystemSettings::isWidescreen, NebulaSystemSettings.cpp:23-25). 11-18 (the harness's Util report, checked at 241395b49): the screen's width and aspect follow the flag too: 608 or 832 units and 16:9 unless the display reports wide (MR::getScreenWidth, getScreenAspect, ScreenUtil.cpp:88-100;
